lede: Monday through Wednesday is budget and levy week for the valley — Telluride Town Council votes November 17th on the 2027 budget and property tax levy, and tucked inside that same meeting is a second reading on suspending the Open Space Fund's RETT dedication for the year, a real tension worth watching. Ouray City Council is doing the same thing that night, adopting its 2027 budget across four linked resolutions and setting the mill levy. The Fire District board takes up its own budget second reading and a financing presentation on November 17th, and if you're waiting on workforce housing up on Black Bear Road, the Housing Authority lottery drawings happen that same evening.

notable.stake: Land Use Code and Master Plan updates will shape what gets built in Norwood for years.
